evidence_quotes: As an agentic AI platform serving regulated enterprises, ReN3 faced a compounding set of challenges:
High Inference Costs : Token consumption scaled quickly as customers deployed agents across legal review, procurement, treasury, and compliance workflows.

Data Sovereignty Requirements : Data sovereignty regulations across Southeast Asian markets required LLM workloads to be hosted locally (e.g., within Singapore), severely limiting which providers could be used.
Rapid Model Innovation : ReN3 needed access to rapidly evolving foundation models to keep pace with innovation and rising customer expectations.

Training and fine-tuning on frontier models had to be both affordable and flexible, so the platform could deliver increasingly accurate results without locking customers into a single vendor's roadmap or geography.
